description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer, adding {C}{C}.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Propeller Pioneer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
